skills.skill_desc: Layla's damage increases with distance, from 100% to 115% at 6 units or farther. This effect does not apply to Turrets.

Layla fires a <font color="a6aafb">Malefic Bomb</font> in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit (can Crit).

If <font color="a6aafb">Malefic Bomb</font> hits an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> gain extra range for 3s. She also gains 60% Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The Movement Speed boost lasts twice as long if an enemy hero is hit.

Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target, dealing 170<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies and applying a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font> to the target for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font>, she deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.25s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: The range of <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Layla's sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded. 
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line.
